lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's fifty-six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 56? Nope!

lines.text: Mia walks from A to B, going only right or up. She can't pass through corner X.
lines.caption: Mia walks from A to B, going only right or up. She can't pass through corner X.

lines.text: How many different paths can she take?
lines.caption: How many different paths can she take?

lines.text: Write on each corner how many ways Mia can reach it. The edge streets get ones.
lines.caption: Write on each corner how many ways Mia can reach it. The edge streets get ones.

lines.text: Each corner adds the number on its left and the one below. X gets a zero.
lines.caption: Each corner adds the number on its left and the one below. X gets a zero.

lines.text: Now watch the numbers fill the grid!
lines.caption: Now watch the numbers fill the grid!

lines.text: B gets seventeen plus nine. That's twenty-six!
lines.caption: B gets 17 plus 9. That's 26!

lines.text: Fifty-six was the trap. It forgets about X!
lines.caption: 56 was the trap. It forgets about X!

lines.text: Did you get twenty-six? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 26? Tell me below!
